sources.snippet: Overview gemma-4-12B-coder-fable5-composer2.5-v1-GGUF is a specialized fine-tuned version of Google's Gemma 4 12B instruction model designed for Python coding tasks, developed by yuxinlu1. The model is distributed as GGUF quantized files (Q2_K at 4.5 GB through Q8_0 at 11.8 GB) and runs locally using llama.cpp, LM Studio, Jan, or Ollama.
